_help: Hand corrections applied by build_camels_atlas.py. Key each entry by arXiv ID (e.g. 2010.00619),
ADS bibcode, or the paper's title as it appears on the CAMELS publications page.
Fields (all optional): topic (exact topic name, or 'Unassigned (new papers)'), date ('2025', '2025-06'
or '2025-06-30'), abstract, url, link (label of the link), title, authors (list of names),
hide (true leaves the entry out of the site), comment (free text, ignored), and id (keep the paper's
earlier ID after its title or link changed on the publications page; the build suggests the line).
Keys starting with '_' are ignored. The build reports every correction it applies.

Leveraging Machine Learning and Hydrodyn.comment: PhD thesis without abstract; the automatic topic (from its title) was wrong.
